mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d.contentid, d.contenttypeid, d.title, d.addr1, d.firstimage2, NVL(d.addr1, s.SIGNGU_NAME) AS regionName, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT * FROM destination WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND contenttypeid != 15 AND contenttypeid != 25 ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(contentid) ASC ) d LEFT JOIN ldong_signgu_code s ON d.lDongRegnCd = s.LDONGREGNCD AND d.lDongSignguCd = s.LDONGSIGNGUCD WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{limit} ) WHERE rn > #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM destination WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND contenttypeid != 15 AND contenttypeid != 25

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.pln_id AS plnId, p.pln_title AS plnTitle, p.start_date AS startDate, p.end_date AS endDate, p.total_days AS totalDays, p.m_id AS mId, m.m_nickname AS memberNickname, p.lDongRegnCd, p.lDongSignguCd, CASE WHEN p.lDongRegnCd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE p.lDongRegnCd WHEN '11' THEN '서울' WHEN '26' THEN '부산' WHEN '27' THEN '대구' WHEN '28' THEN '인천' WHEN '29' THEN '광주' WHEN '30' THEN '대전' WHEN '31' THEN '울산' WHEN '36' THEN '세종' WHEN '41' THEN '경기' WHEN '42' THEN '강원' WHEN '43' THEN '충북' WHEN '44' THEN '충남' WHEN '45' THEN '전북' WHEN '46' THEN '전남' WHEN '47' THEN '경북' WHEN '48' THEN '경남' WHEN '50' THEN '제주' WHEN '51' THEN '강원' WHEN '52' THEN '전북' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END AS sidoName, NVL(s.SIGNGU_NAME, '') AS signguName, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT * FROM planner WHERE LOWER(pln_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND is_public = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC ) p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.m_id = m.m_id LEFT JOIN ldong_signgu_code s ON p.lDongRegnCd = s.LDONGREGNCD AND p.lDongSignguCd = s.LDONGSIGNGUCD WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{limit} ) WHERE rn > #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planner WHERE LOWER(pln_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND is_public = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT innerQuery.*, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT 'destination' AS searchType, TO_CHAR(d.contentid) AS id, d.contenttypeid, d.title, NVL(d.addr1, '') AS addr1, d.firstimage2, NVL(d.addr1, s.SIGNGU_NAME) AS regionName, '' AS memberNickname, '' AS sidoName, '' AS signguName, NULL AS startDate, NULL AS endDate, 1 AS sortOrder, TO_NUMBER(d.contentid) AS sortKey FROM destination d LEFT JOIN ldong_signgu_code s ON d.lDongRegnCd = s.LDONGREGNCD AND d.lDongSignguCd = s.LDONGSIGNGUCD WHERE LOWER(d.title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND d.contenttypeid != 15 AND d.contenttypeid != 25 UNION ALL SELECT 'planner' AS searchType, TO_CHAR(p.pln_id) AS id, '' AS contenttypeid, p.pln_title AS title, '' AS addr1, '' AS firstimage2, '' AS regionName, NVL(m.m_nickname, '') AS memberNickname, CASE WHEN p.lDongRegnCd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE p.lDongRegnCd WHEN '11' THEN '서울' WHEN '26' THEN '부산' WHEN '27' THEN '대구' WHEN '28' THEN '인천' WHEN '29' THEN '광주' WHEN '30' THEN '대전' WHEN '31' THEN '울산' WHEN '36' THEN '세종' WHEN '41' THEN '경기' WHEN '42' THEN '강원' WHEN '43' THEN '충북' WHEN '44' THEN '충남' WHEN '45' THEN '전북' WHEN '46' THEN '전남' WHEN '47' THEN '경북' WHEN '48' THEN '경남' WHEN '50' THEN '제주' WHEN '51' THEN '강원' WHEN '52' THEN '전북' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END AS sidoName, NVL(s.SIGNGU_NAME, '') AS signguName, p.start_date AS startDate, p.end_date AS endDate, 2 AS sortOrder, p.pln_id AS sortKey FROM planner p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.m_id = m.m_id LEFT JOIN ldong_signgu_code s ON p.lDongRegnCd = s.LDONGREGNCD AND p.lDongSignguCd = s.LDONGSIGNGUCD WHERE LOWER(p.pln_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND p.is_public = 1 ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, sortKey ASC ) innerQuery WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{limit} ) WHERE rn > #{offset}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM destination WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND contenttypeid != 15 AND contenttypeid != 25) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planner WHERE LOWER(pln_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND is_public = 1) FROM dual
